title: Crime
body: Crime affects Wallet funds only; Bank funds are protected. Robbery has a 30-minute robber cooldown and 60-minute victim protection. A victim has 60 seconds to Fight Back; witnesses have three minutes to report through 911. Stolen funds appear in the robber's Wallet but remain reserved until the incident resolves. Successful Fight Back or arrest returns all stolen funds exactly once. Arrest imposes 24-hour bot-command confinement; self-bail or another member's confirmed bail payment releases Crime jail only. Moderation Hotseat remains independent.

fields.incident: Choose an open incident when reporting through 911.
fields.bail: Choose a Crime-jailed member and confirm the exact quoted amount before payment.

steps: Read Wallet-only risk and the cooldown before robbing.
Use Fight Back promptly if you are the victim.
Witnesses may report an open incident once each.
Check Wanted status and the saved incident result.
Use the bail selector and confirmation to release Crime confinement without removing moderation punishment.
